'''Maki'voro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] employed by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by a strike team pursuing [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]].
